title: Consciousness is a caricature of attention, not an empty illusion

statements.text: AST agrees with the idea behind illusionism but calls consciousness a caricature: a distorted model of something real, selective attention, that is built automatically and serves the control of attention.

sources.quote: we argue that consciousness is probably better described as a caricature than an illusion
Consciousness is not an empty illusion. It is a distortion or caricature of something real: selective attention.
